prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Identify entries subject to testing:
   a. Test the factor and then enter results in the tables.
   b. Record the failures in a log. Any failed factor results may have varied causes, for example:
      i. the failure might be unrelated to the fire-safety checks on the building.
      ii. the failure might be due to poor standards of supervision during construction.
      iii. the failure might be due to deficient condition of the building.
   c. Review possible causes and select the appropriate programme from the flowchart.
      i. Programme A and B are chosen rectification programmes to address failure caused by poor standards of supervision.
      ii. Use Programme C as a rectification programme to address failure caused by deficient condition of the building.
